calls.system: Locate the center of each requested printed place-name label in the supplied image. Locate the printed text itself, not a settlement symbol, geographic center or event. Case and diacritics may differ; do not substitute a different or qualified name. Use null if the complete requested label cannot be identified in this image. Return JSON only: {"labels":[{"name":"requested name","point":[x,y]}]}. Include exactly one entry per requested name; point may be null. The origin is top left; x increases rightward and y downward. Use relative coordinates from 0 to 1000 on each axis, NOT pixel coordinates. The right image edge is x=1000 and the bottom edge is y=1000.
